report_markdown:
**Quillforge is building an enterprise sales team.** Three sales roles appeared on its Greenhouse board between 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (two Enterprise Account Executives, one Sales Engineer), counted 2026-11-09, plus a Head of Security. The board had none of them on 2026-11-01. That is consistent with an enterprise push (inference).

Nothing new at Brightpane.
